summary_1line: Krishna, Bhima, and Arjuna reach Magadha, defile a sacred peak to provoke Jarasandha, enter disguised as Brahmanas, and gain audience with the unsuspecting king.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna, Bhima, and Arjuna shoot and shatter the revered Chaityaka peak above Girivraja while sacred drums fall silent.
The three heroes, disguised as Brahmanas yet broad‑chested like lions, stride through Magadha’s crowded gates wearing stolen flower garlands.
At midnight Jarasandha respectfully receives the mysterious Brahmana guests in his sacrificial hall, unaware they are his enemies.
